gen-flavors-gf-savate: Stubby, cheeky, loud. Savate follows with open curves and a tall rounded o, so a long stretch of it reads smooth and unhurried beneath Flavors.
gen-flavors-rubik: Flavors goes big and bossy, with a towering x-height and no shading. Rubik does the quiet work, its soft round letters staying legible even when set small and its lowercase looking generous next to the capitals.
gen-fraunces-archivo: Lightly engraved, brass-plaque dignity up top. Fraunces handles the bookish, gently contrasted display work, while Archivo's tall lowercase and outward-opening curves do the everyday reading.
gen-fraunces-fs-public-sans: Trustworthy, first of all, and a touch bookish too: Fraunces writes like a dip pen used gently. Public Sans follows with a hefty lowercase, so it can be sized modestly and still hold its ground.
gen-fraunces-fs-spline-sans: Spline Sans reads smooth and modern, with wide gaps where curves meet stems and every stroke the same weight. Over a full page it feels steady and approachable.
gen-fraunces-space-grotesk: Dignified from the first line, Fraunces trims its thin strokes only slightly below the stems, with generous openings on every curve. And Space Grotesk carries a longer read in a single constant ribbon of line, geometric and breathable without any fuss.
gen-fraunces-work-sans: Fraunces opens up every curve terminal, giving its moderate contrast a gentle taper from stem to joint. Work Sans then runs a marker-like constant line with a high mean line, so a long page feels crisp and modern.
gen-fredoka-fs-alpino: Alpino is cozy and casual, with a very tall body and curve endings kept well apart. Fredoka does friendly with its single-width pen line, while Alpino does the quiet part of keeping text close and compact.
gen-fredoka-fs-bespoke-sans: Bespoke Sans looks sharp and refined, with generous space at each curve end. A long passage in it reads crisp and orderly, a nice foil to Fredoka's round, friendly heading.
gen-fredoka-fs-bespoke-serif: Bespoke Serif brings authority, its thin strokes about half the weight of thick ones. Fredoka's uniform, friendly line sits above it, and the wedge-like pressure in the serif's curves gives the pair a pleasing bite.
